column:Ref Business Expense.Description: "ลบค่าใช้จ่ายแล้ว รายการโอนคืนเงินนี้ยังคงอยู่ ให้บันทึกเงินที่รับคืนจริงแยกต่างหาก / Deleting an expense retains its reimbursement transfer. Record any actual cash return separately."
column:Ref Business Expense.ValidIf: IF([Entry Origin] = "System", LIST([_THIS]), SELECT(Business Expenses[Row ID], AND([Amount] > 0, [Ref Paid By Cash Holder] = "ch:tommy")))

column:Ref From Cash Account.ValidIf: SELECT(Cash Accounts[Row ID], AND([Ref Cash Holder] = [_THISROW].[Ref From Cash Holder], OR([Active], AND([Row ID] = LOOKUP([_THISROW].[Row ID], "Cash Ledger", "Row ID", "Ref From Cash Account"), AND(IN([_THISROW].[Row ID], Cash Ledger[Row ID]), [_THISROW].[Movement Date] = LOOKUP([_THISROW].[Row ID], "Cash Ledger", "Row ID", "Movement Date"), [_THISROW].[Amount] = LOOKUP([_THISROW].[Row ID], "Cash Ledger", "Row ID", "Amount"), [_THISROW].[Ref From Cash Holder] = LOOKUP([_THISROW].[Row ID], "Cash Ledger", "Row ID", "Ref From Cash Holder"), [_THISROW].[Ref To Cash Holder] = LOOKUP([_THISROW].[Row ID], "Cash Ledger", "Row ID", "Ref To Cash Holder"), [_THISROW].[Ref From Cash Account] = LOOKUP([_THISROW].[Row ID], "Cash Ledger", "Row ID", "Ref From Cash Account"), [_THISROW].[Ref To Cash Account] = LOOKUP([_THISROW].[Row ID], "Cash Ledger", "Row ID", "Ref To Cash Account"))))))
column:Ref From Cash Account.Invalid value error: "เลือกบัญชีที่เปิดใช้งานและตรงกับผู้ถือเงินต้นทาง ก่อนเปลี่ยนจำนวน วันที่ หรือบัญชี / Choose an active account belonging to the sending cash holder before changing amount, date, or accounts."

column:Ref To Cash Account.ValidIf: SELECT(Cash Accounts[Row ID], AND([Ref Cash Holder] = [_THISROW].[Ref To Cash Holder], [Row ID] <> [_THISROW].[Ref From Cash Account], OR([Active], AND([Row ID] = LOOKUP([_THISROW].[Row ID], "Cash Ledger", "Row ID", "Ref To Cash Account"), AND(IN([_THISROW].[Row ID], Cash Ledger[Row ID]), [_THISROW].[Movement Date] = LOOKUP([_THISROW].[Row ID], "Cash Ledger", "Row ID", "Movement Date"), [_THISROW].[Amount] = LOOKUP([_THISROW].[Row ID], "Cash Ledger", "Row ID", "Amount"), [_THISROW].[Ref From Cash Holder] = LOOKUP([_THISROW].[Row ID], "Cash Ledger", "Row ID", "Ref From Cash Holder"), [_THISROW].[Ref To Cash Holder] = LOOKUP([_THISROW].[Row ID], "Cash Ledger", "Row ID", "Ref To Cash Holder"), [_THISROW].[Ref From Cash Account] = LOOKUP([_THISROW].[Row ID], "Cash Ledger", "Row ID", "Ref From Cash Account"), [_THISROW].[Ref To Cash Account] = LOOKUP([_THISROW].[Row ID], "Cash Ledger", "Row ID", "Ref To Cash Account"))))))
column:Ref To Cash Account.Invalid value error: "เลือกบัญชีที่เปิดใช้งานของผู้รับ และต่างจากบัญชีต้นทาง / Choose an active account belonging to the receiving cash holder, different from the sending account."

column:Amount.ValidIf: AND([_THIS] > 0, OR(AND(IN([Row ID], Settlements[Row ID]), LOOKUP([Row ID], "Settlements", "Row ID", "Status") <> "Cancelled", [_THIS] = LOOKUP([Row ID], "Settlements", "Row ID", "Amount"), [Ref Partner] = LOOKUP([Row ID], "Settlements", "Row ID", "Ref Partner")), [_THIS] <= [Ref Partner].[Net Profit Earned] - SUM(SELECT(Settlements[Amount], AND([Ref Partner] = [_THISROW].[Ref Partner], [Row ID] <> [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Status] <> "Cancelled")))))
column:Amount.Invalid value error: "ยอดจ่ายต้องมากกว่า 0 และไม่เกินกำไรที่ยังจ่ายได้ กรุณาซิงค์เพื่อตรวจยอดล่าสุด / The settlement must be positive and within the available profit. Sync to check the latest amount."

column:Ref Paid From Cash Account.ValidIf: SELECT(Cash Accounts[Row ID], AND([Ref Cash Holder] = "ch:lisa", OR([Active], AND(IN([_THISROW].[Row ID], Settlements[Row ID]), [Row ID] = LOOKUP([_THISROW].[Row ID], "Settlements", "Row ID", "Ref Paid From Cash Account"), OR([_THISROW].[Status] <> "Completed", LOOKUP([_THISROW].[Row ID], "Settlements", "Row ID", "Status") = "Completed")))))
column:Ref Paid From Cash Account.RequiredIf: AND([Status] = "Completed", OR(NOT(IN([Row ID], Settlements[Row ID])), LOOKUP([Row ID], "Settlements", "Row ID", "Status") <> "Completed", [_THIS] <> LOOKUP([Row ID], "Settlements", "Row ID", "Ref Paid From Cash Account")))
column:Ref Paid From Cash Account.EditableIf: OR(NOT(IN([Row ID], Settlements[Row ID])), IN([Status], LIST("Pending", "Completed")))
column:Ref Paid From Cash Account.Initial value: ANY(SELECT(Cash Accounts[Row ID], AND([Active], [Default Account], [Ref Cash Holder] = "ch:lisa")))
column:Ref Paid From Cash Account.Invalid value error: "เลือกบัญชี Lisa ที่เปิดใช้งานก่อนยืนยันโอน / Select an active Lisa account before completing the transfer."

column:Settlement Guidance.Content: CONCATENATE("กำไรที่ยังจ่ายได้ (ซิงค์ล่าสุด) / Available profit (last sync): ", [Ref Partner].[Net Profit Earned] - SUM(SELECT(Settlements[Amount], AND([Ref Partner] = [_THISROW].[Ref Partner], [Row ID] <> [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Status] <> "Cancelled"))), ". ยอดจ่ายใหม่หรือยอดที่แก้ไขต้องเป็นบวกและไม่เกินกำไรที่ยังจ่ายได้ / New or changed amounts must be positive and within available profit. การยืนยันโอนต้องใช้บัญชี Lisa ที่เปิดใช้งาน กรุณาแก้ไข บันทึก และซิงค์ก่อน / Entering Completed requires an active Lisa account. Edit, save and sync first. ใช้ Reverse/Cancel เพื่อเปลี่ยนสถานะ / Use Reverse/Cancel for status transitions.")

properties.OnlyIf: AND([Status] = "Pending", OR(AND(ISNOTBLANK([Ref Paid From Cash Account]), [Ref Paid From Cash Account].[Active], [Ref Paid From Cash Account].[Ref Cash Holder] = "ch:lisa"), COUNT(SELECT(Cash Accounts[Row ID], AND([Active], [Default Account], [Ref Cash Holder] = "ch:lisa"))) > 0))
